limitations: GitHub search, topics and REST metadata unavailable (HTTP 403 policy); topic coverage relies on packages with keywords, WebSearch, documentation and paper links (PI-D-023).
repos.ecosyste.ms is a mirror with its own sync lag; which of two same-HEAD paths GitHub treats as current cannot be read without the GitHub API (PI-D-025 takes the recorded path).
Selection from returned names was analyst judgment; 2,023 returned names remain unscreened, 264 of them match need terms (EXCLUSIONS.md).
Independent discovery: 99 of 132 candidates (74 of the first 107); the rest rest on seeds, analyst-named PyPI lookups, name-bearing queries or post-annotation confirmation.
WebSearch results carry no body hash.
Per-file license scan reads headers (first 40 lines), nested license files and submodules; a header is a lead, not a determination; model-weight licenses on Hugging Face not read.
Code evidence proves a symbol is defined at the pin, not that it works for these targets.
